buildUnderTest.note: The blank literature sidebar was finally traced to the internal protocol: the injected page script reported state with location.href = 'ibm-webvpn://...', which in WebView2 is a real navigation and leaves the publisher page with its document, scripts and injected toolbar intact but no first paint at all. Replaying the app's own scripts against a copy of its WebView2 profile in Edge reproduced it exactly, and switching that single call to window.open made the same page render. beta7 therefore sends every internal command through window.open (handled by handle_internal_command from on_new_window, with on_navigation as a fallback). Live selector verification is still pending: no publisher rule was promoted from an unverified page.
